Academic Project · Research Dissertation

Determinants of Green ICT Adoption in Indian IT Firms

A Quantitative Study in the Bangalore IT Sector

What actually drives an IT company to adopt Green ICT practices? This study tests six factors — awareness, policies, technology, organisational culture, organisational characteristics, and perceived environmental and organisational benefits — against real survey data from IT professionals in Bangalore.

Findings, Direct from Chapter V

Six hypotheses, tested against 196 respondents

Each of the six independent variables was tested for a positive relationship with Green ICT Adoption. Three were accepted, three were rejected — drawn directly from the study's own conclusion in Chapter V.
